name: Giftwrap
summary: Design a PKR gift card, then watch it drop into a box, get ribboned and bowed, and launch away
about: A gift card sender for a small boutique. Pick an occasion (Eid, Birthday, Thank you or Wedding) and the card and box change colour and pattern; choose PKR 1,000, 2,500, 5,000 or your own amount and the number rolls on the card while your name and note appear live. Wrap and send checks the email or mobile number, then the card drops into a box, the lid lands with a squash, ribbons draw round it, the bow ties itself, the tag swings and the box hops twice before launching off in confetti.
how: Choose an occasion; the card, its pattern and the gift box restyle themselves.
Pick an amount or tap Other and type one from PKR 500 to 50,000; the card rolls to the new number.
Add who it is for, an email or a mobile number like 0300 1234567, and a short note.
Press Wrap and send: wrong details shake with a clear message, right ones start the boxing and ribbon sequence.
The receipt shows a real gift code you can copy; Send another starts a fresh card.
